Hey Amanda, how have you been holding up lately?
Hi, honestly, it's been a tough couple of days. I finally had the big talk with Bill, and we decided to break up.
I'm really sorry to hear that. It sounds like a really difficult decision to come to. Do you want to talk about what happened?
Yeah, it's just... we've been together for three years, but we've been stuck on what our future looks like. Our life goals just don't align anymore.
That must be so hard, especially after investing so much time and emotion into the relationship. How are you feeling about it all?
A mix of emotions, really. I feel sad and a little lost. But there's also relief, you know? Like, at least now I can move forward instead of being in limbo.
